en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from someone who raised it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
Whenever you see the man as being of abundant in Salāt, abundant in Fasts, so do not be boasting with him until you look at how (good) his intellect is’’.
